items.title: Magicians：是否应把共识层协议预设参数暴露给 EVM
items.note: 04:16：自 EIP-4788 起合约可用 SSZ 证明验证 BeaconState 字段，但罚没系数等预设只存在于客户端代码中，合约只能硬编码或依赖治理维护的表；提议在 BeaconState 中加入 preset_root 承诺。
items.title_en: Magicians: should consensus layer protocol presets be exposed to the EVM?
items.note_en: 04:16: since EIP-4788 contracts can verify BeaconState fields with SSZ proofs, but presets such as slashing quotients live only in client code, so contracts hardcode them or rely on governance maintained tables; the post proposes a preset_root commitment in BeaconState.

keywords_en: Starknet relies on native AA to go quantum resistant
should CL protocol presets be exposed to the EVM
privacy joins Ethereum's 2026 roadmap as an endgame goal
summary_en: EliBenSasson said moving Starknet users to full quantum resistance will be easy, and native AA is the key. ProtocolGuild stressed that privacy is now an explicit endgame goal on Ethereum's 2026 roadmap. The EIPs repo merged potuz's Independent CL/EL Sync proposal. Magicians discussed adding a preset commitment to BeaconState so contracts can verify presets without a trusted party.
